title: DataGemma 2B Release
summary: Google released DataGemma in 2B size on September 12, 2024. Google's same-day announcement described DataGemma as open Gemma variants using Data Commons and retrieval-based approaches to ground language-model responses in real-world statistical information.
significance: A dated Gemma-family release milestone focused on grounding language-model responses with Data Commons.

verification.note: Google AI for Developers' official Gemma release ledger explicitly records release of DataGemma in 2B size on September 12, 2024. Google's same-day official announcement states that DataGemma models were available to researchers and developers and describes RIG and RAG approaches using Data Commons. Google DeepMind's official DataGemma page independently describes fine-tuned Gemma 2 models integrating retrieval techniques with Data Commons.
